notes.title: Office Simulator Patch - v0.1.9
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hey Employees[/h1][/b]

[b]Another exciting update has arrived! 🚀 This patch adds fresh improvements and polish to make your office life smoother and more enjoyable. Take a look at what’s new:[/b]

[h2]Update notes[/h2]
[list]
[*]You can now see employees names when you approach them
[*]Added a new file editing task
[*]Added new sound effects. (Character movement sounds, environmental sounds)
[*]Ambient brightness has been increased because the office is dark at some hours before the lights are turned on.
[*]Added walking and running effects to the character for realistic gameplay
[*]A bug with the elevator has been resolved.
[*]Fixed bug employee interaction 
[*]Fixed many minor bugs
[*]Made some minor adjustments to the game economy
[/list]

Your feedback is very valuable to us. For a more flawless office, you can give feedback via the discord channel or the steam community.

Please do not forget to leave a review on the steam page 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399040/Office_Simulator/

Have Fun!

notes.title: Office Simulator Patch - v0.1.8
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hey Employees[/h1][/b]

[b]A long-awaited update is here! This patch brings two highly requested features to the game, making your progress more rewarding and secure. Check out the details below:[/b]

[h2]Update notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Steam Cloud [/b]support added – your save files will now be stored in the cloud and synced across devices. (On first launch after the update, your existing saves will be uploaded to the cloud. If any conflicts occur, choose the Cloud version to keep your latest progress.)
[*]Steam Achievements are now live – complete challenges and show off your milestones.
[*]The game now continues running in the background. Time, tasks, and progress won’t pause when the window is unfocused
[*]Minor improvements and optimizations for a smoother experience.
[/list]

Your feedback is very valuable to us. For a more flawless office, you can give feedback via the discord channel or the steam community.

Please do not forget to leave a review on the steam page 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399040/Office_Simulator/

Have Fun!

notes.title: Office Simulator Customization Patch - v0.1.6
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hey Employees[/h1][/b]

[b]A brand new update is here! This patch introduces a highly requested feature customization! Along with that, it brings new content, improvements, and important fixes. Full details below:[/b]

[h2]Update notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Customization update is now live! You can now paint walls, change floor textures, build new rooms, and more to personalize your office.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45350625/37771abde85baaac7f16b86a04ea077cee4696af.gif[/img]

[*] New items have been added to the store to support your customization options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45350625/74669033b16a05235b6fe146756d4846985b9dc3.gif[/img]
[*] Fixed a bug related to lighting.
[*] Fixed several visual bugs.
[*] Localization issues have been corrected across multiple languages.
[*] Fixed an issue where some tasks would get stuck and not complete properly.
[*] Minor balance changes have been made to improve the gameplay experience.
[*] Performance has been improved for a smoother experience.
[/list]

[h2][b]Coming in the Next Update[/b][/h2]
Here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming in the next major update:
[*]  Steam Cloud and Steam Achievements support will be added.
[*]  Name cards will be added to name desks and rooms.
[*]  New tasks will be introduced.
[*]  A few more employees will join your workforce.
[*]  A breakdown system will be added for electronic devices — keep an eye on faulty equipment!

Your feedback is very valuable to us. For a more flawless office, you can give feedback via the discord channel or the steam community.

Please do not forget to leave a review on the steam page 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399040/Office_Simulator/

Have Fun!

notes.title: Office Simulator Patch v0.1.5
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hey Employees[/h1][/b]

[b]A brand new update is here! This patch brings several improvements, new features, and important bug fixes. Full details below:[/b]

[h2]Update notes[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Good news! You can now wash your hands in the restroom! Don’t forget to clean up after using the toilet
[*]  Employees will now occasionally ask for your support. Helping them will grant you extra tasks and bonus rewards
[*]  Several new tasks have been added
[*]  Added a few new employees
[*]  Bidding system has been rebalanced
[*]  You can now accept more than 5 tasks at once. The maximum number of tasks you can take will increase based on your rank
[*]  A bug preventing bids from being completed even after all employee work was finished has been fixed
[*] Some UI designs have been updated
[*] You can now use the phone interface with your keyboard’s number keys.
[*] Finally, a few simple bugs have been fixed
[/list]

[h2][b]Coming in the Next Update[/b][/h2]
Here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming in the next major update:
[*]  Steam Cloud and Steam Achievements support will be added.
[*]  You’ll be able to customize walls and floors for office decoration. The in-game shop will also [*]  include new items like walls, glass panels, and room dividers to build interior office spaces.
[*]  New tasks will be introduced.
[*]  A few more employees will join your workforce.
[*]  A breakdown system will be added for electronic devices — keep an eye on faulty equipment!

Your feedback is very valuable to us. For a more flawless office, you can give feedback via the discord channel or the steam community.

Please do not forget to leave a review on the steam page 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399040/Office_Simulator/

Have Fun!
